This post details the security functionality of the v2.44 pacemaker. For general operations consult the hardcopy documentation, or request another copy from support@kellisBio.com ---------------------------------------------
The firmware for the v2.44 chip was written by Eidolon Soft. Version control, queries and updates are handled through their central server, located at:
111.105.22.1
As only builds singed by their internal services, using our key will run on the chips, no other company can producing working code for the chips without having them compile it. Issues with the remote monitor software and interface of external access to the chips should be directed at them. Their contact email for such requests and queries is support@eidolonsoft.com
